summary: Thread-safe increment of a counter field at this+0x4 guarded against a -1 sentinel. Enters a critical section on a local synchronization object, increments the counter unless it holds the -1 sentinel, then leaves the critical section and returns its status. The -1 guard makes the increment conditional on the counter not being in a disabled/closed state.

operations.description: Enter the critical section: call sub_59A54D on the local 4-byte synchronization object v4 to acquire the lock.
Read the counter field this[1] (byte offset 0x4, RW); the increment path is taken only when the value is not the -1 sentinel.
Increment the counter in place: this[1] = this[1] + 1.
Leave the critical section: call sub_59A5E9 on the same local object v4 to release the lock, and use its return value as the function result.
Return the status produced by the lock-release call sub_59A5E9.

unresolved: What object the -1 sentinel represents (disabled/closed state) is not established here.
Whether the counter at this+0x4 is a reference count, sequence number, or other counter is unresolved.
The lock helpers sub_59A54D / sub_59A5E9 are not identified beyond being acquire/release of a 4-byte critical-section object.
